record_rules: A trusted receipt is issued by an independently authenticated backend, absent from this package.
Synthetic fixtures can test validators but cannot satisfy physical campaign evidence.
Service request, job acknowledgement, completion and safe-to-unload are different events.
All required condition/cycle cells must be nonempty and unique.
Measured, source-reported, fitted and simulated records have separate data classes.
A source photo or numerical field is never raw local measurement.
whole_paper_completion: All 32 physical branches plus ancestor, control and cleanup evidence; a selected episode can never earn whole-paper execution status.
validator_scope: Static references, qualified-input presence, explicit condition dimensions, synthetic record/transfer/service/cycle bookkeeping. No authentication, numerical science, grasp feasibility or device execution.
unvalidated_dimensions: Material and chemical safety of supplied qualified cards
Authenticity of signatures, custody and instrument receipts
Numerical scientific correctness and all relevant uncertainty models
Detailed robot kinematics, collision geometry and flexible-body dynamics
Exhaustive chronological ordering of membership-only operation receipt lists
